title: HeliNY
specs: Views of NYC landmarks including Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Central Park, Brooklyn Bridge
Nighttime flights available for romantic proposals with panoramic views
Special holiday tours during Thanksgiving with views of Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade and holiday lights
Valid government-issued photo ID required for guests 18 or older
Children 2 years and older must purchase a seat; under 2 may lap sit with valid ID
Maximum weight limit 275 lbs (124.7 kg) per passenger; must provide approximate weight at booking and be weighed at arrival
No alcohol or drugs allowed on flights; guests under influence may be refused service
Helicopters seat six passengers; private tours available for proposals and special events
Mercedes Sprinter van transportation accommodates 12-14 guests per trip for NJ tours
includes: Roundtrip Mercedes Sprinter van transportation for NJ tours
gap: Exact minimum age for children not stated
blurb: Guests take helicopter tours over New York City and New Jersey, viewing iconic landmarks such as the Statue of Liberty, Central Park, and the Manhattan skyline. Tours range from 12 to 45 minutes and include live pilot narration and noise-cancelling headsets. Special experiences include private flights, proposal packages, and holiday-themed tours.
extraNote: Free cancellation up to 72 hours prior to flight except blackout periods · No refunds for cancellations within 72 hours of flight or no-shows · Check-in required 30 min before NYC flights before 3:30PM, 45 min after 3:30PM; 50 min before NJ flights · Refunds outside 72 hours subject to credit card processing fee · Changes 72-48 hours prior non-refundable but reschedulable up to 1 year; 48-24 hours reschedulable with $100pp fee; within 24 hours non-refundable and no reschedule except force majeure · HeliNY not liable for delays or cancellations due to weather, government activities, emergencies, or mechanical issues · Downtown Manhattan Heliport or Linden Airport, NJ depending on tour
